verdict.justification: The project describes the development of a web application for Quality Colombia S.A that aims to support the management of business activities. The application is designed to complement the existing MANAGER-ERP application, which focuses on financial and tax functions. The Balanced ScoreCard methodology is used in this new application to help businesses make decisions, as it includes indicators for four categories: Financial, Customers, Learning and Growth, Internal Processes. This project falls under the category of Enterprise information systems.
